elements.label: Figure 4.9
elements.title: Technical nontariff measures generally have negative impacts on exports from developing countries
elements.content:
Chart type: Coefficient plot (dot/square/diamond plot across three panels).
X-axis: Coefficient, ranging from -0.25 to 0.25.
Legend:
- Binary measure of nontariff measures, negative impact (red square)
- Other measure of nontariff measures, negative impact (red diamond)
- Ad valorem equivalent of nontariff measures, negative impact (red circle)
- Binary indicator of nontariff measures, positive impact (green square)
- Other indicator of nontariff measures, positive impact (green diamond)
- Ad valorem equivalent of nontariff measures, positive impact (green circle)

Panel a. Sanitary and phytosanitary measures
- Developing: Red squares around -0.16 and -0.05, red diamond at 0, green diamond around 0.11.
- Developed: Red squares around -0.19 and -0.16, green squares around 0.21 and 0.25, green diamond around 0.28.
- All countries: Green square around 0.21.

Panel b. Technical barriers to trade
- Developing: Red squares around -0.21, -0.09, and -0.04; green square around 0.24.
- Developed: Red square around -0.26; green squares around 0.02, 0.05, and 0.08; green square around 0.31.
- All countries: Green square around 0.10.

Panel c. Both sanitary and phytosanitary measures and technical barriers to trade
- Developing: Red circles around -0.23, -0.13, and -0.12; green square around 0.16.
- Developed: Red circle around -0.11; green circles around 0.09; green square around 0.14.
- All countries: Red circles around -0.22 and -0.07; green square around 0.15.

Sources: WDR 2025 team analysis, based on Disdier et al. 2008; Fernandes et al. 2019; Fontagné and Orefice 2018; Fontagné et al. 2015; Hoekman and Nicita 2011; Iodice and Reverdy 2025; Murina and Nicita 2017; Zavala et al. 2023.
Note: The figure shows point estimates of coefficients from regressions in selected studies. The dependent variable is log exports by origin country. An ad valorem equivalent is a conversion of a nontariff trade barrier into an equivalent percentage tariff.
